d="$HOME/.cache/zeta-test/bin"; mkdir -p "$d" && t=$(mktemp "$d/.zeta-helper.XXXXXX") || exit 1; if cat > "$t" && [ "$(sha256sum < "$t")" = "b4d644d4279594903f1a9911956432d9473041f2984fc6014c14d7402c7d126c  -" ] && chmod 755 "$t" && mv -f "$t" "$HOME/.cache/zeta-test/bin/zeta-helper-e3b0c44298fc1c14"; then for o in "$d"/zeta-helper-*; do [ "$o" = "$HOME/.cache/zeta-test/bin/zeta-helper-e3b0c44298fc1c14" ] || rm -f "$o"; done; l="$d/.zeta-helper.link.$$"; ln -sfn "zeta-helper-e3b0c44298fc1c14" "$l" && mv -f "$l" "$d/zeta-helper"; else rm -f "$t"; echo 'zeta-helper 没有完整传过去' >&2; exit 1; fi
